items.problem: For harness settings, `settingsIssues` checks only the schema. harness-settings.schema.json:364 says `imageMethod` must be the name of a `resourceGeneration` method whose `resourceTypes` has `image`, but nothing enforces that. `ogw settings set harness imageMethod ace-step` (or a typo) is written as given. Then `gameImageMethod` returns it for every game that has no final image yet, and image keys silently get only `flux2-klein temporary`, so every image stays `temporary`
